title: Development well design
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met: a design is created from a scheduled well so it is scoped to that well's plan and field; a target depth without its unit is refused; the casing check validates the design's inputs and records a result linked to the design version, passing or failing; an incomplete design cannot be approved and the refusal names every missing item; a revision appends a version and retains the previous one.

dataModel.decision: DevelopmentPlanning had no well-design persistence: the schedule row carries only the well, target reservoir, AFE cost and dates. DEV-03's own contract and acceptance criteria were implemented as three DevelopmentPlanning-owned tables, registered in DevelopmentPlanningModule, following the FDP_DRAFT/FDP_BASELINE (DEV-02) pattern.
tables: DEVELOPMENT_WELL_DESIGN (DESIGN_ID key, SCHEDULE_ID, FDP_ID, FIELD_ID, PLANNED_WELL_ID, WELL_NAME, VERSION, CURRENT_IND, DESIGN_STATE, OBJECTIVE, TARGET_FORMATION, TARGET_DEPTH, DEPTH_OUOM, TRAJECTORY_INTENT, COMPLETION_CONCEPT, RISK_TEXT, ESTIMATED_COST, COST_CURRENCY, SPUD_WINDOW_START/END, APPROVED_BY/AT, REVISION_REASON, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT) - versioned; a revision appends and marks the previous row not current
DEVELOPMENT_CASING_STRING (CASING_STRING_ID key, DESIGN_ID, STRING_ORDER, STRING_NAME, OD, WEIGHT, GRADE, SET_DEPTH, DEPTH_OUOM) - the design's casing outline, which is the check's input
DEVELOPMENT_CASING_CHECK (CHECK_ID key, DESIGN_ID, OUTCOME, FINDINGS_TEXT, CHECKED_BY, CHECKED_AT) - the recorded, design-linked check result
dataModel.registration: Beep.OilandGas.DevelopmentPlanning/Modules/DevelopmentPlanningModule.cs registers the three types; --smoke now reports 361 entity types (up from 358).

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Development/OgWellDesign.cs (OgCasingString, OgCasingCheck, OgDevelopmentWell, OgWellDesignValues, OgCasingStringRequest, OgDesignSchedule, OgWellDesignWorkspace, OgWellDesignDetail, IOgWellDesign, OgWellDesignService with MissingItems/CheckCasing/Validate/CreateAsync/SaveAsync/ApproveAsync/ReviseAsync/AddCasingStringAsync/RunCasingCheckAsync)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/WellDesignPageView.cs (route 'welldesign': scheduled-well picker, design grid, design fields, casing grid, add string, check, approve, cost revision)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgWellDesign), OgApplication.WellDesign, catalog 'welldesign' (OgModuleKeys.Development), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.consistencyFix: DEV-01's source list and plan-attention route now point at the real pages: 'fdpreview' became 'fdpwizard' (DEV-02's route) and 'welldesign' lost its ArrivesWith placeholder, so the workspace links resolve.
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/WellDesignTests.cs (10, no database) + WellDesignGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

integration.database: SQLite with FIELD_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN, DEVELOPMENT_WELL_SCHEDULE, DEVELOPMENT_WELL_DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT_CASING_STRING and DEVELOPMENT_CASING_CHECK, seeded in WellDesignGatewayTests
integration.ac1_scope: CreateAsync('SCH-1') produces a design whose FDP_ID='FDP-1' and FIELD_ID='F-1' come from the schedule, and target formation and AFE cost are carried over; a second design for SCH-1 is refused with well-design-exists
integration.ac1_field_match: SCH-3 sits in field F-1 but its plan FDP-2 is in field F-2; CreateAsync is refused with well-design-field-mismatch, and the workspace does not offer that schedule
integration.ac2_unit: SaveAsync with target depth 2400 and no unit is refused with well-design-depth-unit-required; with unit 'm' it is stored and the design shows '2400 m'
integration.ac3_check: with no casing the check is refused with well-design-casing-required; after three consistent strings the check records PASS with a finding that names what was verified; adding a fourth string set shallower than the third makes the next check record FAIL with 'not deeper'
integration.ac4_incomplete: approving before the casing outline exists is refused with well-design-incomplete and the message names 'Casing scheme'
integration.ac5_version: ReviseAsync writes version 2 with the new cost 14.25, copies the four casing strings, and marks version 1 CURRENT_IND='N'; version 1 is still readable at cost 12.5 and is not current
integration.locked: after approval a further SaveAsync on that version is refused with well-design-locked
integration.workspace: before any design the workspace lists two designable schedules and neither SCH-OTHER (another field) nor SCH-3 (plan/field mismatch); after the revision it shows one current design at version 2, approved, and one remaining undesigned schedule

gates.AC-1 A development well is scoped to one: pass - the design takes its plan and field from the scheduled well and a schedule whose plan belongs to another field is refused; one design per scheduled well; the workspace filters by field and plan.
gates.AC-2 Target depth carries a unit: pass - OgWellDesignService.Validate refuses a depth above zero without a unit, the entity stores DEPTH_OUOM beside TARGET_DEPTH, and HasDepth requires both; the gateway test proves the refusal and the stored value.
gates.AC-3 The casing check passes its inputs: pass - CheckCasing verifies the outline (name, OD, grade, set depth, unit, unit agreement, increasing set depths, nothing set below the target depth) and RunCasingCheckAsync records PASS or FAIL in DEVELOPMENT_CASING_CHECK with DESIGN_ID pointing at the version it checked.
gates.AC-4 An incomplete design blocks drillin: pass - MissingItems returns the eight named gaps, CanAuthorProgram is false while any is missing, approval is refused with the list, and DEV-05's authoring screen can call the same rule (that screen does not exist yet).
gates.AC-5 Cost revisions are versioned: pass - ReviseAsync appends a new row with a higher VERSION and CURRENT_IND='Y', marks the previous row 'N', copies the casing outline, and stores the reason; the old version remains readable.

limits: The casing check is an input/consistency check, not a design calculation. Burst, collapse and tension ratings belong to ENG-02 (not built), and the page says so rather than implying a rating was computed.

The schematic preview is represented by the recorded gate and its reason ('disabled: no casing string is recorded yet'); no schematic is rendered on this page. The renderer exists in the WellTools project and can be wired when DEV-05 needs it.
Trajectory is recorded as intent text only; well-plan geometry, survey uncertainty and anti-collision are ENG-01/ENG-06 and are not attempted here.

The runtime permission names in the feature doc (development.welldesign.write / .approve, engineering.casing.read) are not enforced by this page: the app's role model gates pages, not per-command permissions, and the feature doc's permissions are a future RBAC addition.
The design copies target formation, AFE cost, currency and the planned dates from the schedule at creation only; schedule changes afterwards do not rewrite the design.
The new tables need the DEVELOPMENT_PLANNING module applied again on an existing database to be created.
